issue.subject: bluestore: max_bytes_for_level_multiplier < 1 hangs OSD mkfs/mount in RocksDBBlueFSVolumeSelector
issue.description:
|Kind|hang (100% CPU) in OSD mkfs/mount and ceph-bluestore-tool instead of an error| |Severity|minor| |Config|RocksDB option @max_bytes_for_level_multiplier < 1@ (via @bluestore_rocksdb_options[_annex]@); default policy @bluestore_volume_selection_policy=use_some_extra@ with @bluestore_volume_selection_reserved=0@; a dedicated DB device larger than level0 + base (about 2 GiB with defaults: 16M x 64 + 1G)| |Affected|main. Reproduced on origin/main 8e6a13e7a9a| h3. Summary @RocksDBBlueFSVolumeSelector@ is constructed with @rocks_opts.max_bytes_for_level_multiplier@ (a double, BlueStore.cc:7955-7962) and stores it in @uint64_t level_multiplier@ (BlueFS.h:1270). Any value below 1 truncates to 0. @update_from_config()@ (BlueFS.h:1319-1333) then loops 
do { uint64_t next_level = cur_level * level_multiplier; ... } while (true);
Once @cur_level@ is 0 the threshold stops growing, and if the DB volume is larger than it the loop never ends. Non-integer values above 1 are silently truncated as well. A multiplier below 1 is a nonsensical RocksDB setting; the bug is that it hangs instead of being rejected. h3. Reproduction @repro.sh@: mkfs with a dedicated 4G DB and @--bluestore-rocksdb-options-annex=max_bytes_for_level_multiplier=0.5@, with multiplier 10 as the control; each run is killed after 60 s. h3. Observed (origin/main 8e6a13e7a9a) 
== mkfs with dedicated 4G DB, max_bytes_for_level_multiplier=10 (60s timeout)
rc=0 elapsed=3s  (137/killed at 60s = hang)
== mkfs with dedicated 4G DB, max_bytes_for_level_multiplier=0.5 (60s timeout)
rc=137 elapsed=60s  (137/killed at 60s = hang)
gdb on the spinning process (run manually): 
#0  RocksDBBlueFSVolumeSelector::update_from_config (...) at src/os/bluestore/BlueFS.h:1324
#1  BlueStore::_open_bluefs (create=true, read_only=false)
#4  BlueStore::mkfs ()
h3. Suggested fix Keep the multiplier as a double, validate it (>= 1, and base > 0), and bound the loop. h3. Reproducer files * "repro.sh":https://github.com/cephtools/tools/tree/main/trackers/bluestore-2026-09/11-vselector-level-multiplier-hang/repro.sh * Test patch for all gtests: "bluestore-bughunt-tests.patch":https://github.com/cephtools/tools/tree/main/trackers/bluestore-2026-09/common/patches/bluestore-bughunt-tests.patch
